column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-dev-shows-v2 - TV show tracker (one item per tracked show, watchers embedded). completedAt is absent while a show is active - its absence is what active means. members season & episode are 1-based. Keyed (groupId HASH, id RANGE): the group is the partition, so reading a household's feed is one Query and no row can be addressed from another household. Supersedes the id-keyed RoommateStatus-dev-shows table, whose rows the 2026-07-21-01 migration copied here.
